Capital Resources: As of September 30, 2026, pursuant to the terms of our $1.5 billion revolving credit facility, we had $1.187 billion of available borrowing capacity, net of outstanding borrowings ($310 million) and letters of credit ($3 million). Stock Repurchase Program: In connection with our stock repurchase program, shares of our Class B Common Stock may be repurchased, from time to time as conditions allow, on the open market or in negotiated private transactions. Pursuant to this program, during the third quarter of 2026, we have repurchased 1.35 million shares at an aggregate cost of approximately $242.1 million (average price of approximately $179 per share). During the first nine months of 2026, we have repurchased 3.915 million shares at an aggregate cost of approximately $689.6 million (average price of approximately $176 per share). As of September 30, 2026, we had an aggregate available repurchase authorization of approximately $735.4 million pursuant to our stock repurchase program. Conference call information: We will hold a conference call for investors and analysts at 8:00 a.m. eastern time on October 28, 2026. A live webcast of the call will be available on our website at www.uhs.com . To participate via telephone, please register in advance at this link . Upon registration, all telephone participants will receive a confirmation email detailing how to join the conference call, including the dial-in number along with a unique passcode and registrant ID that can be used to access the call. Supplemental financial disclosures related to our financial results are available on our website.
